source: A public hosted IBM i 7.5, captured 2026-10-18 with the ibmi-svrmap-info and ibmi-signon-info scripts (dump option).
signon_reply_note: Rebuilt from the code points the live server sent, in the order it sent them. The 8 byte server seed is a placeholder (0102030405060708), the real one is one time and was never kept. Plain and TLS ports answered with the same fields; only the job number differed.
